page_purpose: The Bell’s two rings and the theft

printable.text: Tara explains that the Bell must ring twice on every ChandRush night. The first ring opens the fair. The second ring opens the Moon Path so ChandRush can fold into its silver wagons and leave before moonset.

visual_notes.text: • Location: Entry Court beside the empty circular Moon Bell stand on its stepped base. Location reference: ENTRY COURT.png. Camera: medium three-quarter view from the volunteers’ side towards Tara and the stand. Static visual: Tara stands beside the vacant suspension ring, holding her staff in her left hand and raising two fingers of her right hand to explain the two bell rings. Ahana is visible at frame-left in three-quarter profile, supporting her open sketchbook with both hands, pages towards her torso, and looking at Tara with concern. Vihaan stands beside Ahana with hands lowered and eyebrows raised; Navya stands closest to the stand, left hand at her pouch, watching Tara’s two raised fingers intently. The circular Bell stand is empty; its hanging rope remains. The map is on the wall between the stand and the dark Lantern Street arch. No Moon Bell is present in Entry Court. Night; the Lantern Street arch beyond remains dark. printable.text: Then she tells them what happened before the opening. While ChandRush was being prepared, a tall figure entered the hidden staff route carrying an old silver ticket and a polished walking stick. The figure stole the Moon Bell and moved through the fair.
